description: This file defines a JobProvider class used in a Flutter application to manage job posts, including loading nearby jobs and calculating distances between locations. It includes a helper function for Haversine distance calculation and manages state to notify UI components of changes.

classes.name: JobProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that provides job data, including loading jobs near a location with distance filtering and notifying listeners of state changes.

methods.name: loadJobsNear
methods.description: Asynchronously loads mock job posts near a specified latitude and longitude, filtering them based on maximum distance, and sorts them by proximity.
